method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a date module (built-in date functions only), a seat-neutral core (lss-core.l4), the injured person's seat layer and a second seat for the owner, driver or other person the Authority recovers from (ss 45, 46), neither restating a rule; answers are named outcomes, no MAYBE BOOLEAN, so no NOTHING-kind tags; three regulative rules (ss 35(2)/37(3), 38(3), 52(1)) run by EVALTRACE; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Motor Vehicle Accidents (Lifetime Support Scheme) Act 2013 (SA), register version 2.12.2019, fetched from www.legislation.sa.gov.au on 2026-11-06 (unauthorised RTF; not the Open Australian Legal Corpus), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/motor-vehicle-accidents-lifetime-support-scheme-act-2013.txt (text sha256 0347276cb2672bb43b0502b980a8eb08d9398dd812ef9bd62ee0e0a29056ac2c per its meta.json). The Motor Vehicle Accidents (Lifetime Support Scheme) Regulations 2014 (version 30.5.2017, deposited at ../../../motor-vehicle-accidents-lifetime-support-scheme-regulations-2014/) were read: they prescribe nothing the claimant provisions use (no s 4(1)(l) need, no s 33 determination, no s 36(1)(e) matter, no excluded cost). The LSS Rules (s 56) are not deposited; every criterion, period or limit they set is asked as a fact.

seats: the person injured in a motor vehicle accident (the applicant or participant in the Lifetime Support Scheme), or a person with lawful authority to act for them (lss-seat.l4)
the owner or driver of an uninsured vehicle, or another person partly at fault, from whom the Lifetime Support Authority recovers the cost of a participant's care (lss-seat-owner-driver.l4)
